generated.details: Three palm-sized abstract clay forms, each with a flattened resting base and softly pinched terracotta body, sit together near the cropped left tabletop corner beside the printer.
A small handmade tile grid consists of uneven cream ceramic squares mounted in spaced rows on the upper-left wall.
At the extreme lower right, a low studio pedestal has a square top joined to a solid rectangular wooden body, its bottom cropped.
One small abstract plaster prototype rests flat on its top, formed as a broad-footed arch with a continuous curved bridge.
